summary: Phase I review — all 4 new features verified end-to-end on the deployed preview URL. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (tiers, omega hero, form-links CRUD + upload, application approval welcome-email). Frontend: admin sees Add featured photo + Add tribute on /omega, Add link + Quick links on /documents, and on application approval the toast clearly surfaces the Resend rejection as a warning (no silent success). Member correctly sees none of the admin controls.

issues: Dialog content warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — accessibility-only, low priority

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the form-link editor and hero editor dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC for /api/omega/hero and /api/form-links CRUD uses admin_tab_dep('members'). This means a membership_manager (mm.tx) — which has 'members' in its tabs — CAN write the Omega hero and form-links. Spec only explicitly required 403 for member + governor_manager, both of which are correctly blocked. If product intent is full-admin-only, switch to require_admin or a dedicated tab key (e.g., 'omega' / 'pages').
server.py is now ~5100 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Suggest splitting into modules (auth, members, events, news, omega, form_links, tiers, ai) under a /app/backend/routes/ package.

_send_approval_email correctly returns (ok, detail) and the frontend toast.warning surfaces detail — good. Detail strings come straight from Resend SDK exception text; consider trimming/sanitising before sending to clients in case the SDK exposes any internal hints.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up: TEST_Form A link (created+deleted via API), TEST_UI_Link (created+deleted via UI), TEST_Founder hero banner (set then cleared), 2 disposable applicants (test.welcome.*@example.com) — corresponding users + applications removed via API/Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_phase_i.py (19 tests). All Phase I features green. Remember Resend free-tier limitation: welcome_email_sent will be false for non-owner recipients — that is expected behaviour, verify only that the frontend warning toast renders (already verified in iter-12). When testing application approval through the UI, navigate to /admin then click the 'Members' tab — Pending applications panel mounts inside MembersTab.
